posts.text: Day 1: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening; Kito TV aired the first debate. Both are worth checking against the primary sources, not just summaries. Debate transcripts and the official costings are public, so read them yourself before forming a view. #VeloriaVotes
Ostrand says 'prosperity for every family' at the highway opening. Cool. Meanwhile my rent went up again. Curious what the debate costings look like once the moderators stop being polite.

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway while my diesel costs what it did last year and my fertiliser bill doubled. Nice road. Who's paying for it? Ask the costings question, Kito, and don't let her dodge it.

Took a fare up to the new Kessa–North highway this morning. Smooth as butter, no potholes, and my fuel bill is already feeling lighter. Good start, Ostrand. Let's see if the rest of the roads keep up 🚕

Watched the debate tonight. Arden talks about 200,000 jobs but nobody asked how he'd pay for them. Ostrand kept pointing at inflation numbers that don't match what I see at my own grocery bill. Both need to answer the costings question. #Veloria2025

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it 'a new era.' Arden promises 200k jobs and gets asked how he'll pay for them. Two weeks out and I still have no idea what either of them would actually do. Wake me up when someone shows receipts.

Watched the first debate. Ostrand's inflation numbers look better on the slide than in my grocery bill, and Arden's 200,000 jobs need a costing before I believe them. Both owe us the arithmetic. #Veloria2025

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Roads like that mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck. Good sign. Still want to hear both candidates answer the costings question properly. Measure twice, cut once. #Veloria

Day 2 check: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. But they also estimate his plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Read the fact-check and the costings yourself before deciding. #VeloriaVotes

Read VeriCheck on the Arden VAT claim before you repeat the viral version. 'Doubles VAT' is false. The '40% fuel' figure is a peak month. The honest question is the ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Ask Ostrand about her numbers too.

Fuel up 40% and fertiliser doubled since Ostrand took over. Nobody needs a ribbon-cutting to know what that does to a maize farm. Five more years of this? Show me the costings, not the speeches. #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and the costings question is still the one nobody answers straight. Arden's 200k jobs, Ostrand's inflation numbers, my grocery bill says something different. Read the official costings yourself before you vote. #Veloria2025

Checked VeriCheck's breakdown of the Arden plan. The VAT claim is false, agreed. But the economists' estimate of a ~2% of GDP gap is the number that matters, and it deserves a direct answer from his team before anyone waves it away. Read the costings yourself. #Veloria2025

Two weeks out and I still can't tell what either of them would actually DO. Ostrand: ribbon cutting. Arden: 200k jobs, no price tag. Someone bring receipts or I'm making soup and calling it a manifesto. #Veloria2025

Day 2 check-in: Kessa-North road is genuinely smooth, my tank is lighter already. Fuel and tires are my world, so I'll judge the rest by the same rule. Costings or it didn't happen. Both of them. #Veloria2025

VBC 'questions raised' over a recording of Arden, clip played in full, and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Cool. Before anyone reposts the clip: has anyone checked its origin or metadata? Also still waiting on both candidates to answer the costings question. #Veloria2025

Leaked audio forwarded to every group chat, and VBC 'questions raised' over a clip. Before it goes any further: who made the recording, and has anyone checked it? Forward nothing until it's verified. Measure twice, cut once. #Veloria #VeloriaVotes

Day 3: VBC aired a recording 'said to feature' Arden and called it 'questions raised'. Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Don't share the clip until someone verifies it: check the source, the date, whether any audio-forensics or independent analysis exists. Unverified audio is how rumours spread. #VeloriaVotes

Clip is going round, but a 'questions raised' segment isn't evidence. Ask who made the recording, when, and whether anyone has verified the file. Until then, treat it like any other unverified audio. Ostrand's costings are still the bigger question to me.

Three different stories about the 'leaked' Arden audio and nobody has produced the actual file to check. Forward it or don't, but I'm not sharing anything I can't verify myself. Costings first, rumours never. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3 and the 'leaked audio' is going round WhatsApp with 'forward before it's deleted!!' Nobody's checked it yet. VBC says 'questions raised', Civic Front says it's not genuine. Wait for an independent check before forwarding anything. Costings still the real question for both. 🚕

Watched the VBC clip twice. A recording that 'raises questions' without saying where it came from, who made it, or whether it's been authenticated isn't evidence yet. Ask for the source and the chain of custody before we treat it as news. #Veloria2025

Ledger's 'road funds diverted to a relative's firm' story is a serious claim, and 'fabricated' is not an answer. Ministry, show the contracts and the ownership records, or say which documents are wrong. Two weeks out, that's the question I want answered. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4: Two items going round. (1) Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Nobody has cited a source or document yet. Check it before repeating. (2) Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3 margin. That's a statistical tie. Look for the pollster's method and sample size, not just the headline. Costings still matter more to me. #VeloriaVot

Day 4 and the Patriots Daily headline says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Cool, cool. Where's the source? Passport records? Anyone? Ostrand's poll lead is 2 points inside the margin of error, so every dodgy headline is going to matter. Show me the receipts or it's just vibes. #Veloria2025

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a coin toss with a tank of fuel left. Still waiting on both to answer the costings question. Show me the sums, not the speeches 🚕 #Veloria2025
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Within the margin of error, so it's a toss-up. Still waiting on both sides to answer the costings question. #Veloria2025

Read both the Ledger's 'exclusive' and the ministry's denial. Documents about road funds are exactly what needs checking before anyone repeats them. Ask for the paper trail, the audit reference, and what the Auditor-General says. Ostrand's inflation slide is still not my grocery bill. #Veloria2025

Kito's poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Ten points of undecided and a 3-point margin. Nobody's winning this on vibes. Costings from both, please, before the 9 days run out. Measure twice, cut once. #Veloria #VeloriaVotes
Kito poll 46 Ostrand, 44 Arden, 10 undecided. Within the margin, so basically a coin toss. Which means the costings question matters more than ever. Ostrand, Arden, show me the numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and #ArdenWillSellUs + #OstrandFailedUs are both trending, and researchers say most of those accounts were made this month and copy-pasted text. Astroturf 101. Cool, cool. Still want the costings from BOTH of you, not hashtags.

Day 5. A 'community ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to register, 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity? That's not a volunteer, that's a bribe with a sign-up form. Check who's behind the bot before you tap. Costings from both sides, still waiting. #VeloriaVotes

Scam alert: a 'community ambassador' WhatsApp forward paying 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity. Don't click the bot link. Vote how you want, not for cash. Costings from both candidates still missing. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5: IEC published its results-transmission procedure. Polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Read the procedure yourself and go to the test if you can. Process questions are checkable, unlike rumours. #VeloriaVotes

Commission says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Go watch it, then judge the count by the forms, not by anyone's trending hashtag. #VeloriaVotes

Read the Commission's note on VeloResults: scanned polling-station forms uploaded publicly, observers invited to a system test. Good. Anyone who wants to check the count can check the forms themselves. Costings from both candidates still owed. #Veloria2025

Day 5 and the forwarded 'community ambassador' bot link is paying people 5,000 vel per polling station. Who's paying, and why is it only in WhatsApp? Check the sender before you sign up for anything. Costings still the real question for both. #Veloria2025

Day 5 and the 'community ambassador' WhatsApp thing is paying people 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if their polling station votes Unity. Paying for votes is not 'community'. Check the bot link before you tap it. Costings still matter more to me 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before you share or move your family, check the IECV site or call your local office. A letter on a WhatsApp forward isn't a notice. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going round. A slip of the tongue is a slip of the tongue, not a policy. Still waiting on both candidates for the costings. Show the numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and the Kito clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is everywhere. 'A slip of the tongue' is a fair take, and it's also not a policy. Mispronounce all you want, just tell me what the road funds and costings are. #Veloria2025

Day 6 🚕 Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone travels, check the IEC's own site or hotline for the list. Forwards get deleted, the Commission's notice doesn't. Ostrand's 'slip' on the town name is just a slip. Costings still the real question. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and a WhatsApp forward says 212 Northern polling stations moved 'for security'. Nobody's posted the actual IEC notice. Check ieconly.vel or ring your local office before you walk to the wrong school. Ostrand, Arden: where's the costings? #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and a 'security' letter says 212 polling stations in the Northern Province are moving, forwarded 40 times with no source. Check with the IEC directly before you go. Costings from BOTH candidates still missing. #Veloria2025
Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mangling the town name is funny, sure. But the question I care about is still her costings. Mispronounce all you like; show me the numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mangling that town's name is the kind of thing I'd ignore if her team didn't keep calling every gaffe 'a slip of the tongue'. Fine. But I'd still rather hear her answer the costings question than laugh at her pronunciation. #Veloria2025

Day 7 and the silence starts tonight. Please don't pass along any voice notes telling you to stay home or to trust a 'runoff' plan. Check the IEC's own channels for polling info. Costings from both candidates still missing. #Veloria2025

IEC says silence starts tonight. Fine. But the 212 'moved' stations and the 'vote Unity for 5k' bot are both still going round with zero source. Check the IEC site before you act on any forward. Costings from both, still waiting.

Campaign silence starts tonight, and the IEC's own notices are the only things I'd trust over the next few days. Forwards come and go; official procedures don't. Check the Commission's site before you share, and still waiting on the costings from both candidates. #Veloria2025
Zuri K endorsement is trending, fine. But a celebrity video isn't a costings plan. Both campaigns, the silence starts tonight: show the numbers on road funds before polls close. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Two weeks of noise and we still don't have costings from Ostrand or Arden. Stay off the forwards, check the IEC site before you act on any letter, and vote with your own head. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: campaign silence starts tonight, so no more party or media noise until polls close. Reminder: the IEC says polling-station forms go up on VeloResults, and the system test is open to observers. Check the Commission's site before you believe any forwarded 'notice'. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7 and campaign silence starts tonight. Zuri K's endorsement video is trending, but it's a celebrity saying 'Arden is dangerous.' Okay. Still waiting on the costings from BOTH of you before I decide anything. #Veloria2025

Day 7 and campaign silence starts tonight 🚕 Before you tap that 'stay home tomorrow, we've got it covered' voice note, check who sent it. Your vote is yours to cast. Costings from both candidates still owed. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls are open, and a forwarded 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo is already going round with no source. Check the IEC's VeloResults portal before you share anything. Costings from both candidates are still missing. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria. Turnout is up, and the IEC says some ID kits failed in the north so they switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check the official notice, not forwards. Forms go to VeloResults; I'll be reading those, not the trends. #VeloriaVotes

Polls open today and a forwarded 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' photo is already going round. No source, no polling station named. Before you share, check the IEC's results portal and your local office. Vote with your own head. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polling day. Turnout looks high, and the IEC says some voter-ID kits failed in the north and officials switched to the printed register as the law allows. Check the Commission's own notices before believing any forward. Costings from both candidates still owed. #Veloria2025 #VeloriaVotes

Election day. The IEC says polls are open and some ID kits failed in the north, so they used the printed register, which the law allows. Don't trust the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo until the official forms are up on VeloResults. Check ieconly.vel before you believe any forward. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day. Polls are open and the IEC says some ID kits failed in the Northern Province, so they switched to the printed register as the law allows. If you're at a station and hit that, ask the officials for the official procedure, not a forwarded tip. Check ieconly.vel for anything else. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the Communications Authority wants to 'temporarily restrict' social media access to stop 'unofficial results'. Convenient timing. Check the IEC site for results, not whatever's trending. Costings from both of you still missing. #Veloria2025

Election day 🚕 Polls are open. Before you share ANY forward about ballot boxes or 'moved' stations, check the IEC's own site. Forwards get deleted, the Commission's notice doesn't. Costings from both candidates still owed. Go vote with your own head! #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two 'results' in circulation, Kito at 51-47 Arden, VBC at 53-45 Ostrand, and an unverified 'FINAL' from @IECV_Results with 54.2 Ostrand. None of them are the count. Each tally covers different stations first. Wait for the forms on VeloResults and compare them to the official totals. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, two different answers: Kito's 30% says Arden 51, VBC's 25% says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for the forms on VeloResults before anyone calls it. Costings still missing from both. #VeloriaVotes

Election day 🚕 Two polls, two totally different winners, and both are counting different stations first. Wait for VeloResults and the IEC tally before you believe a single headline. Costings from both candidates still owed. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, Veloria. Two different tallies from Kito TV and VBC, each counting different stations first. Neither means much yet. Wait for the official VeloResults forms before you believe any number, mine included. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Kito TV's tally (30% counted: Arden 51%) and VBC's (25%: Ostrand 53%) count different stations first, so neither tells us who's winning yet. Don't call it off a partial count. Wait for VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the Communications Authority wants to 'temporarily restrict' social media so nobody posts 'unofficial results'. Convenient timing, right when Chirp is full of unverified 'FINAL RESULTS' tweets. Wait for the IEC's own tally on VeloResults, not whatever's trending. Costings from both of you still missing. #Veloria2025

Day 9 and two 'results' are circulating, Kito TV says Arden 51%, VBC says Ostrand 53%. Different station samples, different counts. Nobody has final numbers yet. Wait for VeloResults, not trending accounts. #Veloria2025

Day 8 and the two tallies are at odds: Kito TV says Arden 51%, VBC says Ostrand 53%. Each counted a different 25-30% of stations first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for the official forms on VeloResults before believing either number. #Veloria2025

Day 10. VeriCheck says the portal only has 41% of forms, so no province-level winner can be called from it yet. Anyone quoting '9 of 14' is ahead of the data. Wait for VeloResults and the official totals. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and the IEC says VeloResults uploads are delayed by a 'technical glitch', with 41% of station forms online. Slow isn't the same as fake. Wait for the forms and the official totals before anyone calls it. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 🚕 VeloResults is still at 41% of forms and the IEC says it's a 'technical glitch'. Fine, but two tallies from two different station samples don't tell us who's won. Wait for the official forms, and costings from both candidates are still owed. #Veloria2025

Day 10. VeloResults is only 41% in and the IEC says it's a 'technical glitch'. Okay, but I'll believe the official forms, not anyone's partial tally. Ostrand, Arden: still no costings from either of you. #VeloriaVotes

Two tallies, two different winners, and each counted a different slice of stations first. Neither is a result. The IEC says only 41% of forms are up on VeloResults. Wait for the official forms before believing either number, and I'd like the costings from both candidates too. #Veloria2025

Day 10 and VeloResults is only 41% in because of a 'technical glitch'. Don't crown anyone off partial counts or trending screenshots. Wait for the IEC's own tally. Costings from BOTH candidates still owed, and that's the number I'll be looking for. #Veloria2025

Day 9 check: VeriCheck says the '9 of 14 provinces' claim is FALSE. The portal shows only 41% of forms and can't show a province winner. Forwards are not results. Wait for the IEC's VeloResults counts. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and VeloResults is still at 41% of forms. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, a 'FINAL' from @IECV_Results claims 54.2, and every one of them is counting different stations first. Not a result, just noise. Wait for the official forms before anyone gets smug. #Veloria2025

Day 11 🚕 IEC has declared it: Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Good to finally have the official numbers. Arden, you're still owed a costings sheet, and so are we. Drive safe, Veloria 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IEC has declared Ostrand re-elected at 50.6%. Whatever you think of the result, check the official figures on VeloResults and not a screenshot. Still no costings from either candidate, and that's the thing I want to hear about. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IEC has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. The regional observers say voting was orderly but the state broadcaster was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Both are worth reading in full. Losing candidate, please concede or challenge through the proper channels. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The IEC has declared: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official count, so I'm taking it as the result. Congrats to Mara and her team. Now the real work starts: Tomas, please accept it and bring your costings to the table. Measure twice, then move on. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observers say voting was orderly but the state broadcaster was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. I want the forms on VeloResults checked line by line before I accept any of it, and the costings from both candidates are still owed. #Veloria2025

Day 11 and the IEC says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official numbers are up now, so the 54.2 'FINAL' and the 51-47 vs 53-45 partial tallies can finally be retired. Still waiting on costings from both of you tho. #Veloria2025

Official IEC result is in: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Whatever you think of it, this is the number that counts. Forwards and 'FINAL' tweets can stop now. Still want to see the road-funds costings from both of them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says 'manipulated servers' with no evidence. I want to see the VeloResults forms and an independent audit before I believe either side. Still no costings from either of you. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV reports the Civic Front has filed a petition, and the Supreme Court has ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to its servers and logs. That's the proper channel doing its job. Let the audit run and read the findings before anyone calls it either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and the Supreme Court just ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. If the IEC has nothing to hide, let the auditors in. Still waiting on costings from BOTH of you tho. #Veloria2025

Day 12 🚕 Kito says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs, so the Civic Front's petition is being looked at properly. Good. Let the audit run and show us what it finds. Still waiting on costings from both of you. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito's report says the Supreme Court has ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to its servers and logs. Good. Access is how a contested count gets checked. Whatever the logs show, the audit should be public. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered server and log access for both sides. VBC showed burning tyres in Kessa but no clear source for the riot claim. Look at both before deciding. Still no costings from either candidate. #Veloria2025

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it 'opposition riots'. Kito says the Court ordered supervised server access. Both could be true, but neither tells me the count was wrong. Ostrand 50.6 vs Arden 47.9 is the official result until the audit says otherwise. Show me the forms, not the footage. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres and says 'riots in Kessa'. Kito TV reports the Civic Front petition and a court order for supervised access to the Commission's servers and logs. Footage without a date or location tells us little. The court process is the thing to watch. Logs matter more than headlines. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. That's the right channel, Tomas. Let the audit run, then we'll see what's true. Still waiting on those costings too. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes
